## Result

### tests/m1_integration.rs — 7 M1 integration tests, all pass

1. vault_has_one_note_per_ko — 4 seeded KOs (academic_pdf, web_article, annotation, unknown) → rebuild → 4 note files ✓
2. delete_rebuild_diff_empty — delete vault root, rebuild, assert_eq!(first, second) ✓
3. annotation_survives_delete_and_rebuild — annotation note present in both rebuilds, Annotates: wikilink verified ✓
4. vault_rebuild_makes_zero_llm_calls — rebuild succeeds with no ANTHROPIC_API_KEY (documents M1 done-condition 4) ✓
5. exact_match_dedup_no_new_object — second ingest with same hash → LibraryError::IdentityResolution; library still has 1 object ✓
6. version_update_updates_note — same DOI, new hash/title → VersionUpdate path updates existing note ✓
7. query_content_type_filter — query(content_type=AcademicPdf) returns exactly the paper, not article/annotation/unknown ✓

### write_relationship_inserts_row unit test added
Killed the one missed mutant from the initial mutants run.

### Mutant testing (ADR-006)
Target functions: resolve_identity, ingest, render_note, write_relationship
- Found: 12 mutants
- Caught: 10 (83%)
- Missed: 0 ✓
- Unviable: 2 (compile errors: IdentityResult lacks Default; &&→|| type mismatch)

### M1 done-conditions self-check (ROADMAP.md)
1. A command regenerates the vault: alcanzai vault regenerate --library <db> --vault <dir> ✓ (#18)
2. Delete vault + re-run reproduces it (diff empty): delete_rebuild_diff_empty test ✓ (§6 test #5)
3. Human annotation survives delete-and-regenerate: annotation_survives_delete_and_rebuild ✓ (DESIGN.md §9.4)
4. Vault regeneration makes zero LLM calls: vault_rebuild_makes_zero_llm_calls ✓
5. Library is the only durable-state component: SqliteLibrary holds all state; VaultProjection writes files only when render/rebuild is called and reads nothing back ✓

Total tests: 45 (23 unit + 7 M1 integration + 11 membrane + 4 vault_rebuild_integration).
cargo fmt ✓  cargo clippy -D warnings ✓ (0 warnings)  cargo test ✓
